title: FarikApprovedSites
description: Farik's own list of approved sites: the long-established shops the Procurement Specialist may read from its first task, stored as roles/procurement_specialist/approved_sites.yaml. It is public data, not a secret (ADR 0044 keeps Farik's credentials out of the code, and a list of shops is none). farik-roles loads it and refuses, beside what this schema cannot say, a host that is not a bare lower-case ASCII host with a dot (no scheme, path, port, IP address or leading www.) and a host listed twice. See docs/SPEC.md 6.10 and 8.6, and ADR 0039.

sites.description: The shops, in the order they are shown, grouped by the order their categories first appear.

siteCategory.description: What the shop sells, in the ten categories a small business buys in.

host.description: The shop's primary domain: a lower-case ASCII host with a dot, an international name in its xn-- form, and no scheme, path, port, IP address or leading www. A regional domain is a host of its own.

shop.description: The shop's name as the owner reads it, 1 to 60 characters on one line.
